timing: Declared before any registered physical campaign episode
evaluator: Independent Python lossless node/batch reconstruction; no live actuation

tolerances.origin: Existing sol_active_normal_audit.py and sol_active_normal_live_reduce.py; reused without inspecting new campaign outcomes

complete_capture: Check all node source weights/capacity shares, batch order/frozen velocity, activity vs policy masks, requests, weights, targets, clamps, counters, unwind flags, sequential velocity updates, final wrench and energy rejection. Original diagnostic activity does not select weights. Source-bin moments are not exported; node trace is not an independent reconstruction of original source points.
incomplete_capture: Check available prefix using exported full batch state/totals, but refuse independent closure of full active totals, batch velocity delta, final wrench and raw request sums. No missing nodes invented.
matching: Eight traceoff/on pairs across two policies, two hosts, requested workers1/4; exact initial/final CYPS identity and all180steps of physical body/native/application/geometry observations. Timing and trace diagnostic metadata are explicitly excluded; source and raw file hashes retained.
causal_limits: Report first lossless input, arithmetic and wrench differences separately. Complete arithmetic reconstruction proves recorded operations, not unique downstream cause or original SOL clearance.
negative_controls: Deliberately corrupted weights, masks, deltas, batch order, capacity, lengths, overflow completeness and lossless-bit envelope must refuse. Raw SHA binding detects any retained artifact bit change.
performance: Report full getter/observation/simulation distributions and trace payload/storage bytes, all episodes/owners retained. One-repeat sequential observer comparison is not a clean timing experiment, original SOL24group gate, universal60Hz or total memory proof.
